product: Cartesia — speech to text, realtime (Ink WebSocket)

source_audio.description: No audio was submitted and no request was issued: this frame is AUTHORED to the shape Cartesia's documentation declares, deliberately carrying the is_final flag the live service was measured NOT to set. The flush_done message carries no transcript, so no spoken or written content is involved at all.

redaction.notes: Nothing was redacted because nothing was captured. request_id holds the nil GUID — the placeholder form protocol section 4 prescribes for a correlating identifier — because no real request exists to identify.

terms.basis: docs/guides/provider-recording-protocol.md section 7 — no Output was captured at all; the fixture is authored to Cartesia's published protocol documentation. Cartesia's own verdict for a capture is permitted-with-conditions, and it is not what blocks one here (see notes)

source_schema.method: The documented field set of the realtime speech-to-text flush_done message was read from the page above: type, request_id and the documented-deprecated is_final. No vendor example payload, prose or field description was copied — only the documented field names and the literal message-type constant 'flush_done', which is interface, not expression. Every value is our own fiction, and is_final=true is chosen adversarially rather than observed.

notes: THE ADVERSARIAL SHAPE, KEPT ON PURPOSE AND NO LONGER MISDESCRIBED AS A RECORDING. CartesiaSpeechRecognizer deserializes EVERY text frame into its transcript DTO and only then filters on type != "transcript", so a control frame that ALSO carries is_final true is the case where a broken filter leaks an empty transcript through as a final result. WHY THIS IS AUTHORED RATHER THAN CAPTURED, and the reason changed on 2026-08-18: the earlier sidecar said no capture credential existed. One does, and a live session was captured — see flush-done-frame.json, class recorded. What that capture established is that THE SERVICE SENDS is_final FALSE on this frame, so the dangerous shape this fixture carries is one the vendor was measured not to produce. It is retained because the vendor's own documentation declares the field, so a filter that trusts is_final must survive it, and because deleting the only adversarial case in favour of the benign recorded one would have quietly reduced coverage while looking like an upgrade. Worth what an authored fixture is worth and no more: it says what a filter must tolerate, never what the vendor sent.
